title.narrative: Reduction in number of dumpsites

description.narrative: Reduction in number of dumpsites

comment.narrative: Closure of dumpsites 9 months after completion of landfill construction. This is not part of investment programme but commitment of local authorities

EBRDs Progress Report of the intervention covering period up to 31 December 2021 on page 1 states Construction works started in April 2021. The implementation of the project is progressing well with the expected completion of new landfill construction in August 2022. Completion of the remaining project components specialised equipment for landfill and transfer stations operation waste collection trucks waste containers and construction of new waste collection points is planned in end of 2023.Thus the construction work on new landfill is ongoing as of the reporting period. And closure of existing dumpsites is planned once the new landfill becomes operational.

comment.narrative: EBRDs Progress Report of the intervention covering period up to 31 December 2021 on page 1 states A landfill construction contract was awarded in July 2020 to Tunnel Sadd Ariana Co. Iran Armenia with the contract value of EUR 4130651.36 excluding VAT. The technical supervision consultant engineer has been onboard since August 2020. As of June 2022 the following proportion of funds have been disbursed Euro 955206 from EBRD loan Euro 573123 from EU NIF grant Euro 382082 from E5P grantConstruction works started in April 2021. The implementation of the project is progressing well with the expected completion of new landfill construction in August 2022. Completion of the remaining project components specialised equipment for landfill and transfer stations operation waste collection trucks waste containers and construction of new waste collection points is planned in end of 2023.
